Build reports from measurement, G-Study/D-Study, or residual results

Source: R/api-reporting-checklist.R, R/api-reports.R, R/api-results.R
mfrm_report.Rd

Render completed analyses into structured R bundles, Markdown, HTML, or table lists without refitting or upgrading inference. Pass mfrm_results() for consolidated measurement reports (type = NULL), G-Study/D-Study, network, bias, anchor, or posterior results directly, or select a focused component type on a native fit, bias, or DFF object.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_reporting_checklist'
summary(object, top_n = 10, ...)

mfrm_report(
  x,
  style = c("qc", "apa", "validation", "reviewer", "technical", "rater"),
  output = c("object", "markdown", "html", "tables"),
  facet = NULL,
  rater = NULL,
  audience = c("rater", "researcher"),
  label = NULL,
  max_cases = 5,
  interval = NULL,
  intervals = NULL,
  study_context = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

For summary.mfrm_reporting_checklist(), an mfrm_reporting_checklist object and preview row count (10 default).

top_n

For summary.mfrm_reporting_checklist(), an mfrm_reporting_checklist object and preview row count (10 default).

...

Named component options when type is non-NULL (extra arguments without type are rejected).

x

An mfrm_results() bundle, a supported G-Study/D-Study, network, posterior, estimate_bias(), estimate_all_bias(), review_mfrm_anchors(), build_linking_review(), build_model_choice_review(), or recommend_mfrm_design() object; or, when type is non-NULL, the input required by that component.

style

Consolidated report emphasis: "qc" (default), "apa", "validation", "reviewer", "technical", or "rater" (standalone recipient-safe sheet for additive RSM/PCM or two-family GPCM MML; requires facet and rater).

output

Return format when type = NULL: "object" (mfrm_report, or mfrm_rater_feedback when style = "rater"), "markdown", "html", or "tables".

facet

Rater-sheet controls for style = "rater": modeled rater facet and level rater, audience ("rater" or "researcher"), recipient-facing label ("Selected rater" default; source IDs are omitted), unexpected-case count (5 default, 0 omits cases), and optional named saved interval attachment.

rater

Rater-sheet controls for style = "rater": modeled rater facet and level rater, audience ("rater" or "researcher"), recipient-facing label ("Selected rater" default; source IDs are omitted), unexpected-case count (5 default, 0 omits cases), and optional named saved interval attachment.

audience

Rater-sheet controls for style = "rater": modeled rater facet and level rater, audience ("rater" or "researcher"), recipient-facing label ("Selected rater" default; source IDs are omitted), unexpected-case count (5 default, 0 omits cases), and optional named saved interval attachment.

label

Rater-sheet controls for style = "rater": modeled rater facet and level rater, audience ("rater" or "researcher"), recipient-facing label ("Selected rater" default; source IDs are omitted), unexpected-case count (5 default, 0 omits cases), and optional named saved interval attachment.

max_cases

Rater-sheet controls for style = "rater": modeled rater facet and level rater, audience ("rater" or "researcher"), recipient-facing label ("Selected rater" default; source IDs are omitted), unexpected-case count (5 default, 0 omits cases), and optional named saved interval attachment.

interval

Rater-sheet controls for style = "rater": modeled rater facet and level rater, audience ("rater" or "researcher"), recipient-facing label ("Selected rater" default; source IDs are omitted), unexpected-case count (5 default, 0 omits cases), and optional named saved interval attachment.

intervals

Optional saved confint(x) result (or list) for G-Study / D-Study reports (NULL reports points without computing intervals).

study_context

Optional named nonblank character vector of user study declarations (question, rating_unit, score_direction, rubric, etc.); stored verbatim without recoding data or altering eligibility.

type

NULL (consolidated report) or one of the 13 component report types listed below.

Value

For summary(): An object of class summary.mfrm_reporting_checklist with:

  • overview: run-level counts of available and draft-ready items

  • section_summary: section-level checklist coverage

  • software_scope: external-software relationship summary

  • facets_positioning: report-ready FACETS relationship wording

  • visual_scope: available plots and data for custom rendering, including the main InterpretationCheck caveat for each type of plot

  • priority_summary: counts by priority/severity

  • action_items: highest-priority rows that still need draft work

  • settings: checklist settings rendered as a compact table

  • notes: interpretation notes

With non-NULL type, the component's mfrm_bundle or mfrm_reporting_checklist object. With type = NULL, an mfrm_report (mfrm_rater_feedback for style = "rater"), Markdown string, mfrm_report_html, or named list of data.frames.

Details

summary() method: Summarize a reporting-checklist bundle for manuscript work

Reading order and rater-sheet privacy. For consolidated reports, inspect first_screen, report_index, claim_readiness, report_gaps, and template_index (summary(report, view = "reader")). Standalone style = "rater" sheets include only recipient-safe summaries and fixed guidance (uncertainty withholds both bounds when unavailable rather than showing partial or zero-width intervals) and omit source fits, Person IDs, other rater IDs, and free-form notes.

Component reports (type = ...)

type (former alias)InputKey ... options and returned tables
"specifications" (specifications_report)mfrm_fittitle; model/constraint/control summary bundle
"data_quality" (data_quality_report)mfrm_fit or datamin_category_count, min_facet_count; row_review, category/facet counts
"category_structure" (category_structure_report)mfrm_fitdiagnostics; category counts, steps, ordering/collapse flags
"category_curves" (category_curves_report)mfrm_fittheta_range, theta_points, newdata; conditional probability/expected grids
"facet_statistics" (facet_statistics_report)mfrm_fitdiagnostics; per-facet distribution, separation, and fit summaries
"precision" (precision_review_report)mfrm_fit / mfrm_diagnosticsdiagnostics; SE basis, separation tiers, availability reasons
"checklist" (reporting_checklist)mfrm_fitdiagnostics, hierarchical, include_references; checklist, section_summary, visual_scope, software_scope
"reference_review" (reference_case_review)mfrm_fitdiagnostics, bias; schema and numerical consistency review
"iterations" (estimation_iteration_report)mfrm_fitmax_iter; replays optimization from initial values (not stored trace)
"bias_interaction" (bias_interaction_report)mfrm_bias or mfrm_fitfacet_a, facet_b, diagnostics; ranked conditional interaction cells
"bias_iterations" (bias_iteration_report)mfrm_bias or mfrm_fitBias recalibration iteration history
"bias_pairwise" (bias_pairwise_report)mfrm_bias or mfrm_fittarget_facet, context_facet; within-target pairwise bias contrasts
"dff" (dif_report)mfrm_difMethod-specific DFF narrative, cell counts, and link status

References

  • Brennan, R. L. (2003). CASMA Research Report No. 1, University of Iowa.

  • Jiang, Z., et al. (2022). Educ. Psychol. Meas., 82, 705–718. doi:10.1177/00131644211033899 .

Examples

# Long-running workflow; run explicitly when needed.
# example("summary.mfrm_reporting_checklist", run.dontrun = TRUE)
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
toy <- load_mfrmr_data("example_core")
fit <- fit_mfrm(toy, "Person", c("Rater", "Criterion"), "Score",
                method = "MML", quad_points = 7, maxit = 30)
diag <- diagnose_mfrm(fit, residual_pca = "both", diagnostic_mode = "both")
chk <- mfrm_report(type = "checklist", fit, diagnostics = diag)
summary(chk)
} # }
# Long-running workflow; run explicitly when needed.
# example("mfrm_report", run.dontrun = TRUE)
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ratings <- load_mfrmr_data("example_operational")
fit <- fit_mfrm(
  data = ratings, person = "Person", facets = c("Rater", "Criterion"),
  score = "Score", rating_min = 1, rating_max = 4,
  category_policy = "preserve", method = "MML", model = "RSM"
)
res <- mfrm_results(fit)
report <- mfrm_report(res)
summary(report, view = "reader")
summary(mfrm_report(fit, type = "data_quality"))
summary(mfrm_report(fit, type = "checklist"))
mfrm_report(fit, type = "specifications")$summary
recipient <- as.character(fit$prep$levels$Rater[1])
sheet <- mfrm_report(res, style = "rater", facet = "Rater",
                     rater = recipient, output = "html", max_cases = 0)
sheet$path
} # }
